about: The binary dependencies of the implement-from-spec skills: what needs each one and when, how to detect it, the minimum version and where that minimum comes from, and per-platform install recipes read from each vendor's documentation on the checked date. Read only by doctor.py and install.py. Steps are argument arrays; manual steps are printed for the user and never executed; {placeholders} are expanded by depslib.platform_variables.

external-review: the GPT review stage of every implementing skill (core/scripts/spec-external-review.py, core/scripts/bedrock-gpt)

pkgutil must report an Apple-issued Developer ID signature, Apple notarization, and the Developer ID Installer AMZN Mobile LLC (94KV3E626L) with its SHA-256 certificate fingerprint. The AWS CLI install page documents no signer for AWSCLIV2.pkg, so this pin is empirical: it is the installer certificate AWS publishes for the SAM CLI pkg (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/reference-sam-cli-install-verify.html), and AWSCLIV2.pkg signed 2026-10-14 carried exactly that certificate when checked on 2026-10-16. The full pkgutil output is kept in the setup journal

Notarization: trusted by the Apple notary service
Developer ID Installer: AMZN Mobile LLC \(94KV3E626L\)

minimum.source: https://pypi.org/pypi/cfn-lint/json (read 2026-10-16): 1.46.0 of 2026-03-02 is the last release for Python 3.9 (Requires-Python >=3.9), 1.47.0 and later need >=3.10 (1.57.2: >=3.10,<3.15), and the README says "Python 3.10 to 3.14 are supported". An installer running on Python 3.9 silently settles on 1.46.0 with resource schemas frozen in March 2026; this floor reports that as a gap

integrity.detail: the PyPI package over HTTPS, installed by uv into its own environment. --python requests the 3.10 to 3.14 range cfn-lint supports: uv uses a system Python in that range, else downloads a uv-managed CPython (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/python-versions/, read 2026-10-16). Without it uv used Amazon Linux 2023's and RHEL 9's Python 3.9 and resolved cfn-lint 1.46.0

steps.text: when no Python 3.10 to 3.14 was on the system, uv downloaded a managed CPython for cfn-lint; uv python list --only-installed shows it and uv python uninstall removes it once no tool uses it

the archive's sha256 against SHASUMS256.txt, both from https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/ (Node.js 24, the Active LTS line on the checked date). Setup does not check the release signature on SHASUMS256.txt.asc: the Node.js release keyring has many keys and no single fingerprint to pin. To check it yourself, follow https://github.com/nodejs/node#verifying-binaries

SHASUMS256.txt.asc is signed by the Node.js release keys (https://github.com/nodejs/node#verifying-binaries); the keyring has many keys and no single fingerprint to pin, so setup prints these steps instead of running them

steps.text: download the current LTS binary for your platform from https://nodejs.org/en/download (the macOS .pkg or the Linux .tar.xz), check it against SHASUMS256.txt.asc as https://github.com/nodejs/node#verifying-binaries describes, and put its bin/ directory on PATH. Distribution packages and NodeSource are community channels and are often older than Node.js 22
